पारिवारिक पेंशन के लिए मानक कटौती ₹50,000 है, जो नियमित वेतन के समान है।

questions.question_english: Which of the following statements incorrectly compares the standard deduction available under ‘Salaries’ with the standard deduction available under ‘Family Pension’?
options_english: Standard deduction under Salaries is a flat ₹50,000.
Family Pension is taxed under the head ‘Income from Other Sources’.
The deduction for Family Pension under Section 57(iia) is 33.33% of the pension or ₹15,000, whichever is less.
The standard deduction for Family Pension is ₹50,000, identical to regular salary.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that the standard deduction for Family Pension is ₹50,000, identical to regular salary. Salary pension drawn by a retired employee is assessed under Salaries and gets a standard deduction of fifty thousand rupees under Section 16(ia). Family pension paid to legal heirs is taxed under Income from Other Sources, where deduction under Section 57(iia) is limited to thirty-three and one-third percent or fifteen thousand rupees, whichever is less.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। पारिवारिक पेंशन के लिए मानक कटौती ₹50,000 है, जो नियमित वेतन के समान है। सेवानिवृत्त कर्मचारी द्वारा प्राप्त वेतन पेंशन का आकलन वेतन के अंतर्गत किया जाता है और इसे धारा 16(ia) के तहत ₹50,000 की मानक कटौती मिलती है। कानूनी उत्तराधिकारियों को दी गई पारिवारिक पेंशन 'अन्य स्रोतों से आय' के अंतर्गत कर लगाई जाती है, जहाँ धारा 57(iia) के तहत कटौती तीस-तीन और एक-तिहाई प्रतिशत या पंद्रह हजार रुपये, जो भी कम हो, तक सीमित है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Section 16(ia) provides a standard deduction of ₹50,000 for salary pensions.
Family pension is taxed under Income from Other Sources with a limited deduction.
Printed answer key: (D) The standard deduction for Family Pension is ₹50,000, identical to regular salary.

questions.question_english: Under which head of income should a government school teacher declare the remuneration received for checking CBSE board examination papers (which is paid by CBSE, not the employer)?

Profits and Gains of Business or Profession
Income from Other Sources

questions.explanation_english: Remuneration received for checking examination papers from an external agency like the Central Board of Secondary Education does not arise from an employer-employee relationship. Because there is no employer-employee relationship involved between the examiner and the external board, such earnings are legally assessed under the head Income from Other Sources.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। परीक्षा पत्रों की जांच के लिए एक बाहरी एजेंसी जैसे केंद्रीय माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड से प्राप्त वेतन नियोक्ता-कर्मचारी संबंध से उत्पन्न नहीं होता है। चूंकि परीक्षक और बाहरी बोर्ड के बीच कोई नियोक्ता-कर्मचारी संबंध नहीं है, इसलिए ऐसी आय को कानूनी रूप से अन्य स्रोतों से आय के प्रमुख के तहत आंका जाता है।

questions.question_english: Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). Assertion (A): Income from salary is taxable during the financial year in which it is due or received, whichever is earlier. Reason (R): Arrears of salary received in the current year, which were not taxed in earlier years, are exempt from tax in the year of receipt.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Salary income becomes taxable on due or receipt basis, whichever occurs earlier, in accordance with Section 15 of the Income Tax Act. However, salary arrears received in a current year without prior taxation are fully taxable in the year of receipt, though the taxpayer can claim tax relief under Section 89(1) of the Act. Therefore, the assertion is true, but the reason is false.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। वेतन से होने वाली आय उस वित्तीय वर्ष में कर योग्य होती है जिसमें यह देय या प्राप्त होती है, जो भी पहले हो। हालाँकि, वर्तमान वर्ष में प्राप्त वेतन की बकाया राशि, जिसे पिछले वर्षों में कर नहीं लगाया गया था, प्राप्ति के वर्ष में पूरी तरह से कर योग्य होती है। इसलिए, असर्शन सत्य है, लेकिन कारण असत्य है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Section 15 of the Income Tax Act governs the taxation of salary income.
Section 89(1) allows for tax relief on salary arrears.
Printed answer key: (C) A is true but R is false.

questions.question_english: A Principal authorizes a private coaching center to use the school classrooms on Sundays to conduct coaching for engineering entrance exams. The coaching center pays a monthly rent of ₹25,000 to the school. What is the GST implication of this transaction?
options_english: It is completely exempt from GST as the school is an educational institution.
It is fully exempt because the property is utilized exclusively for educational coaching purposes.
Renting property to a commercial entity is a taxable supply under GST.

questions.explanation_english: Renting school premises or facilities to a commercial organization like an external coaching center constitutes a taxable supply of service under GST law. Exemption applies strictly to core educational services provided by the institution to its students, whereas commercial leasing of real estate is taxed under standard applicable GST rates.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। स्कूल परिसर या सुविधाओं को एक व्यावसायिक संगठन जैसे बाहरी कोचिंग केंद्र को किराए पर देना जीएसटी कानून के तहत एक कर योग्य सेवा की आपूर्ति है। छूट केवल संस्थान द्वारा अपने छात्रों को प्रदान की गई मुख्य शैक्षणिक सेवाओं पर लागू होती है, जबकि व्यावसायिक संपत्ति का पट्टा मानक जीएसटी दरों के तहत कर लगाया जाता है।

key_facts: Commercial leasing of school premises is taxable under GST.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following deductions and exemptions:
I. House Rent Allowance (HRA) under Section 10(13A)
II. Leave Travel Allowance (LTA) under Section 10(5)
III. Deduction under Section 80C (PPF, LIC, etc.)
IV. Standard Deduction of ₹50,000 under Section 16(ia)
Which of the above are NOT allowed to be claimed by a salaried employee who opts for the New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC) for FY 2023-24?
options_english: I, II, and III only
I and III only
III and IV only
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english: An employee opting for the New Tax Regime under Section 115BAC for Financial Year 2023-24 cannot claim exemptions for House Rent Allowance, Leave Travel Allowance, or deductions under Chapter VI-A like Section 80C. However, the standard deduction of fifty thousand rupees under Section 16(ia) was explicitly extended to the new regime.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। नए कर व्यवस्था के तहत, एक कर्मचारी हाउस रेंट भत्ता, लीव ट्रैवल भत्ता या धारा 80C के तहत कटौतियों का दावा नहीं कर सकता। हालाँकि, धारा 16(ia) के तहत ₹50,000 की मानक कटौती को नए कर व्यवस्था में स्पष्ट रूप से बढ़ाया गया है।

questions.question_english: A school receives an audit objection stating that several entries in the latest Form 24Q are marked as 'PAN Invalid' due to data entry errors by the DDO. What is the immediate impact of this error on the concerned employees?
options_english: The employees’ bank accounts will be frozen.
The employees will be immediately prosecuted for willful tax evasion by the department.
TDS will not reflect in Form 26AS, blocking tax credit claims during filing.
No impact, as the department automatically maps the names to the correct PANs.
questions.explanation_english: If an employee’s PAN is recorded as invalid in Form 24Q, the tax deducted from their salary cannot be linked to their tax record. As a result, the TDS will not reflect in their Form 26AS, preventing them from claiming corresponding tax credits while filing their annual income tax return.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। यदि किसी कर्मचारी का PAN फॉर्म 24Q में अमान्य के रूप में दर्ज किया गया है, तो उनके वेतन से काटा गया कर उनके कर रिकॉर्ड से नहीं जोड़ा जा सकता है। परिणामस्वरूप, TDS उनके फॉर्म 26AS में परिलक्षित नहीं होगा, जिससे उन्हें अपनी वार्षिक आयकर रिटर्न फाइल करते समय संबंधित कर क्रेडिट का दावा करने से रोका जाएगा।
